name: Label specs
help_text: One row per channel we print unit labels for. The symbology decides what the code may be: EAN-13 takes 13 digits (Takealot prints the product's GTIN); Code 128 takes any printable text (Amazon prints the FNSKU). Open a spec to set what the label carries and in what order — the barcode, the product name, and any fixed text such as Takealot's "MP" or the item condition Amazon requires.
